author: Central STL News
title: Blues prospects honored at World Juniors with medals and top player awards
text:
Enterprise Center | St. Louis Blues
Enterprise Center | St. Louis Blues
St. Louis Blues prospects Love Harenstam and Adam Jiricek received top honors at the 2026 World Junior Championship, where their national teams competed for the gold medal.
The final game saw Harenstam, representing Sweden, and Jiricek, playing for Czechia, face each other for the championship title. Sweden secured a 4-2 victory to claim the gold medal. Both players were recognized for their performances during the tournament.
Harenstam started in all but one of Sweden’s games and played every elimination round match. He was named Best Goalkeeper of the tournament and was selected to the All-Star team. The goaltender was chosen by the St. Louis Blues in the sixth round (179th overall) of the 2025 NHL Draft.
Jiricek helped Czechia earn silver and received the Directorate Award as Best Defender. He was also picked as one of Czechia’s Top Three Players in the tournament after scoring five goals and totaling six points in seven games, including two game-winning goals. Jiricek was drafted by St. Louis in the first round (16th overall) of the 2024 NHL Draft.
"Love Harenstam with incredible back-to-back saves! #WorldJuniorspic.twitter.com/7IzmCeGZ0K," TSN (@TSN_Sports) posted on January 4, 2026.
"ADAM JIRICEK BETWEEN THE LEGS OT WINNER The @BulldogsOHL d-man and #stlblues prospect with one of the best overtime winners in #WorldJuniors history! pic.twitter.com/eL4dx9QXdx," Canadian Hockey League (@CHLHockey) posted on December 29, 2025.
